title: Fix Dark+Light (Both) mode not working
description: The 'Both' mode that should render specimens in both dark and light mode simultaneously does not function correctly. Needs investigation of the mode switching logic and CSS media query or data-attribute handling when both modes should be shown side by side or toggled.

title: Fix surface selection visibility in dark mode

title: Fix cream/off-white background bleed on scroll
description: Unexpected cream-colored background appears in the page background and bleeds through when scrolling. Likely a CSS background or scroll container issue where the body or html element has an unintended color. Needs investigation of root element background colors and overflow/scroll behavior.

Verification: background must be pure white (no warm tint) at all scroll positions. Collision risk: may share CSS root cause with superficies-s40 and superficies-r66 — coordinate or sequence to avoid merge conflicts.

description: The export button is hard to find in the current UI. Users need a clear, prominent path to export their work. Evaluate moving it to the top-level toolbar, adding a keyboard shortcut, or making it a persistent CTA rather than buried in the current location.
notes: HITL DECISION NEEDED: Three approaches listed (top toolbar, keyboard shortcut, persistent CTA). A human must pick one before this is executable. Also: add the current file/component location of the export button to the description.
close_reason: Added accent-colored Export brief button to the topbar (always visible, top-right of main area). Sidebar footer button kept for redundancy.

notes:
## Verification Results (2026-05-04)

### PASS

1. **Cold load defaults** — bare URL initializes to Neobrutalist preset, SaaS archetype, cu=0 ✅
2. **URL round-trip** — complete valid hash reconstructs all state fields correctly ✅
3. **Invalid/partial hash** — graceful fallback to defaults, no crash ✅
4. **Preset application** — switching preset re-applies all preset dimensions ✅
5. **Departure tracking** — dimension change sets cu=1; preset switch resets to cu=0 ✅
6. **Font pairing constraint** — switching from serif→chunky resets body font from serif to system (the only valid pairing for chunky) ✅
7. **Hero layouts** — all 4 patterns render distinctly: hero+features, bento, magazine, sidebar+main ✅
8. **Mode: light** — preview renders correctly ✅
9. **Mode: both** — preview renders correctly, deferred side-by-side note is shown ✅
10. **Mode: dark** — FIXED (see below); all 3 zones now render correctly ✅
11. **Export panel** — opens from sidebar, 3 artifact tabs present ✅
12. **Full brief XML** — deterministic XML output with all fields ✅
13. **Full brief Markdown** — format toggle switches to Markdown with same content ✅
14. **Minimum brief** — compact prompt-style output with visual direction, stack, state handling, a11y target ✅
15. **Token JSON** — machine-readable JSON with all state fields ✅
16. **Desktop chrome** — left sidebar with grouped collapsible sections, Export button at bottom ✅
17. **Mobile chrome** — bottom bar (Edit + Export) at 390px viewport; Edit overlay opens full-screen controls with Close button ✅

### BUG FOUND AND FIXED

**Dark mode hero text invisible** — hero heading rendered dark-on-dark because .shell did not set color: var(--ink). The dark mode override redefines --ink to a light value on .shell, but h2 inside the zone was inheriting color from body which reads :root's --ink (dark navy). Fix: added color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg) to .shell in app.css. All 43 unit tests pass; build clean after fix.

### KNOWN DESIGN NOTES (not bugs)

- accent on surface contrast is 2.12:1 (AA fail) — this is expected for the Acid colorway and is explicitly reported in the token panel per spec
- Light+dark side-by-side preview (mode=both) is explicitly deferred to a later slice per spec
close_reason: All spec checks pass. Dark mode hero text bug found and fixed (color: var(--ink) missing from .shell). 43 tests pass, build clean.
